meta.title: servicenow-sparring
tagline: a read-only MCP server for AI agents.
check ServiceNow claims on a live instance,
meta.description: servicenow-sparring is a read-only MCP server: an AI agent checks claims about ServiceNow against a live instance instead of answering from memory.

beats.line: Not its release, its plugins, or what was customized.
A wrong answer sounds exactly like a right one.
servicenow-sparring lets the agent check a claim against the *live* instance.
Eight functions. Each one answers one question.

items.caption: sn_query
items.line: sn_query: what is really in this table?

items.caption: sn_plugins
items.line: sn_plugins: which plugins and store apps are installed?

items.caption: sn_dependencies
items.line: sn_dependencies: what is attached to this table?

items.caption: sn_upgrade_skips
items.line: sn_upgrade_skips: what did the upgrade skip?

beats.line: It only reads. It sends only GET requests.
No function creates, changes or deletes anything.

scenes.text: A query on a field that does not exist is *refused*.
scenes.sub: ServiceNow would ignore that condition and answer with everything.

beats.line: Every answer names the instance, the table and the query.
So a person can run it again.

scenes.text: “Could not be checked” is never reported as “nothing found”.
scenes.sub: When the evidence does not decide, it says “unknown”.
